messages:
maria: quick heads-up — nightly evals (quantized-1.2) spiked around 03:00 UTC, failure rate on common_qa jumped from ~1% to 8.9%. failing examples show timeouts and odd token diffs. anyone able to triage?

devin: on it. can you paste one of the failing outputs + any stderr?

maria: sure — here's one failure snippet from the harness run:

```
ERROR: SamplingTimeout: step 0->1 exceeded 120s
prompt_id: qa_4312
expected_prefix: "The capital of France is"
generated: "The capital of France is \u0127paris"  <-- stray char and then hang
stderr: kernel loop stuck in sample_step(), kv_cache not advancing
```

Also attached in CI artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/nightly/1938765432/trace.log (large). :eyes:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: deployed tokenizer/2.0 to staging at 2026-11-16T02:45:12Z by @infra-team (release: tokenizer/2.0)

lee: triage hypothesis: tokenizer normalization changed in 2.0 (NFKC vs NFC?) which can shift token boundaries. quantized runtime expects exact tokenization for kv-cache/prefix caching; an off-by-one token can make sampling state diverge and cause stuck loops or long tails.

britt: that would also explain nondeterministic diffs across runs if some runners have tokenizer v1 cached, others v2. did we roll tokenizer in the eval infra recently?

devin: confirmed — some runners upgraded earlier in the week (auto-update). repro quick check:

```
# local quick check
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
t1 = Tokenizer(version='1.9')
t2 = Tokenizer(version='2.0')
s = "Caf\u00e9 in Paris"  # contains composed/combined chars
print(len(t1.encode(s)), len(t2.encode(s)))
# outputs: 42 43
# and sampling with fixed seed diverges after token 10
```

devin: when I forced the harness to normalize prompts with `unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text)` the token lengths matched and the example ran fine. so it's a normalization mismatch + mixed tokenizer versions problem, not RNG leak.

maria: great find. can we patch the harness quickly to apply deterministic normalization on input before tokenization and pin tokenizer for workers until infra patch runs?

lee: yes — short-term: add explicit `NFKC` normalization in the eval harness input pipeline (no model changes). long-term: coord with infra to standardize tokenizer binary across fleets.

britt: I'll open infra ticket to freeze tokenizer updates for nightly fleet and add canary gating. assigning to infra team.

devin: I'll draft PR for harness shim. changes: (1) normalize all prompt strings to NFKC in harness, (2) add a small assertion that token lengths between host and worker match for seed-based tests, and (3) add a telemetry flag to detect mixed tokenizer versions at runtime. quick patch will be behind a feature flag so we can revert.

maria: sounds good. Can you include a regression test that fails when token lengths differ? make it as lightweight as possible.

devin: yep — will add a unit that encodes a handful of accented/unicode edge cases and asserts equality between the harness encoder and worker encoder. will send PR in ~30m.

infrastructure-bot: ticket INF-3121 created: "freeze tokenizer updates on nightly fleet + canary gating" (assigned to infra-team).

maria: marking nightly as blocked until harness patch lands and canary passes. thanks everyone — please post PR link here. :exclamation:
